business_problem: An industry-leading healthcare organization had oncology information scattered across siloed records and unstructured notes, which slowed analytics, clinical-trial matching, treatment comparisons and risk detection for care teams and researchers.
solution_summary: PwC and Google Cloud helped the healthcare organization turn fragmented oncology records into an AI-ready clinical data foundation. Using a prebuilt PwC cloud solution of pipelines, frameworks and deployment tools, the teams ingested and organized lab results, treatment patterns, clinical notes, claims data, pathology reports, biomarker data and social determinants of health on Google Cloud. AI was used both to convert unstructured clinical content into structured data and to identify patient cohorts, surface treatment patterns and flag people who might qualify for trials or need additional support. Google Cloud Vertex AI ran predictive models while Looker delivered analytics dashboards for clinicians and analysts. Built-in monitoring controls tracked data quality so the new environment could support research, real-world evidence generation and privacy-protected external collaboration, letting clinicians spend less time hunting for context and more time making care decisions.

solution_components.name: PwC cloud solution
solution_components.role: Provides the prebuilt pipelines, frameworks and tools used to speed the oncology-data deployment.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the AI-ready oncology data foundation and unified datasets.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Runs predictive models that support trial matching, patient-risk identification and treatment analysis.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud Looker
solution_components.role: Presents analytics dashboards for clinicians and analysts.

data_flow: Structured and unstructured oncology data from health records, claims and third-party sources is ingested through PwC's cloud solution into Google Cloud, where AI converts notes into usable structured information and Vertex AI models identify cohorts, risks and trial opportunities. Looker then delivers the resulting insights to clinicians and analysts.
business_outcome: The healthcare organization gained a reusable oncology-data backbone that speeds insight delivery, supports more personalized care decisions and creates new research and partnership value from privacy-protected health information.
architecture_clues: The platform organizes more than 50 data domains and 2,000-plus tables on Google Cloud.
AI is used both for structuring unstructured content and for predictive clinical analytics.
Vertex AI and Looker are the primary model-serving and insight-delivery layers.
Data-quality monitoring is built into the environment rather than handled separately.
